async def act(page):
    # First, try to locate the status filter on the Orders page
    # It might be a combobox with name 'Status' or similar
    status_filter = page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Status')
    if await status_filter.count() > 0:
        # Set the status to 'Processing'
        await status_filter.select_option(label='Processing')
    else:
        # Alternative: look for an input field or other filter element
        # Try to find a text input for status
        status_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Status')
        if await status_input.count() > 0:
            await status_input.fill('Processing')
        else:
            # If no direct status filter, look for a filter form or section
            # Use a more general approach: find any element that allows filtering
            # For example, a button to open filters
            filter_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Filters')
            if await filter_button.count() > 0:
                await filter_button.click()
                await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
                # After opening filters, try to set status
                status_in_filter = page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Status')
                if await status_in_filter.count() > 0:
                    await status_in_filter.select_option(label='Processing')
                else:
                    # Fallback: use text input
                    status_text = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Status')
                    if await status_text.count() > 0:
                        await status_text.fill('Processing')
    # Apply the filter by clicking a search or apply button
    apply_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Search')
    if await apply_button.count() == 0:
        apply_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Apply')
    if await apply_button.count() == 0:
        apply_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Filter')
    if await apply_button.count() > 0:
        await apply_button.click()
    else:
        # If no apply button, maybe the filter auto-applies on change
        pass
    # Wait for the page to update after filtering
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Now, retrieve the orders list from the page
    # Look for a table or list of orders
    orders_table = page.get_by_role('table')
    if await orders_table.count() > 0:
        # Get the entire table content as text
        orders_text = await orders_table.text_content()
        print(orders_text)
    else:
        # Alternative: look for list items or other structures
        orders_list = page.get_by_role('list')
        if await orders_list.count() > 0:
            orders_text = await orders_list.text_content()
            print(orders_text)
        else:
            # Fallback: print the entire page content or a message
            print('No orders table or list found. Here is the page text:')
            page_text = await page.text_content('body')
            print(page_text)
